name: Drawer
description: Sheet that slides in from the side (or from the bottom on mobile) so a panel of details or actions opens without leaving the page.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the sheet. Example: open={open}

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open the drawer on first render, skipping the enter animation. Example: defaultOpen

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer opens or closes, including swipe and overlay dismissals. Example: onOpenChange={setOpen}

props.name: direction
props.description: Edge the panel slides in from, and the side it is dragged towards to dismiss. Example: direction="right"

props.name: modal
props.description: Block interaction with the page behind the drawer. Example: modal={false}

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Allow drag, outside click and Escape to close the drawer. Example: dismissible={false}

props.name: shouldScaleBackground
props.description: Scale the page behind the drawer while it is open. Example: shouldScaleBackground={false}

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Detent heights the drawer can rest at, from least to most visible. Example: snapPoints={[0.3, 0.6, 1]}

props.name: activeSnapPoint
props.description: Controlled resting snap point. Example: activeSnapPoint={0.6}

props.name: setActiveSnapPoint
props.description: Called when the drawer settles on another snap point. Example: setActiveSnapPoint={setSnap}

props.name: closeThreshold
props.description: Fraction of the drawer height the user must drag before it closes. Example: closeThreshold={0.5}

props.name: handleOnly
props.description: Only the drag handle can move the drawer, not its content. Example: handleOnly

props.name: nested
props.description: Mark the drawer as opened from another drawer so the parent stays mounted. Example: nested

props.name: fixed
props.description: Keep the drawer height fixed and scroll its content when the keyboard opens. Example: fixed

props.name: scrollLockTimeout
props.description: Milliseconds the drawer ignores drags after its content was scrolled. Example: scrollLockTimeout={1000}

props.name: repositionInputs
props.description: Move focused inputs above the on-screen keyboard instead of scrolling them into view. Example: repositionInputs={false}

props.name: container
props.description: Element the drawer portal is rendered into. Example: container={portalRef.current}

props.name: onDrag
props.description: Called continuously while the user drags the drawer. Example: onDrag={(_, p) => setProgress(p)}

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called after the drawer finished closing. Example: onClose={resetForm}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the drawer content. Example: className="max-h-[80vh]"

props.name: children
props.description: Required. DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent and the header/footer parts. Example: <DrawerContent />
